data.long_meaning: Ansh is a Sanskrit word for 'sky' or 'universe'. Shul means 'touch' or 'connection'. Thus, Anshul can be interpreted as 'one who touches the sky' or 'one who has a connection with the universe'. The name Anshul carries the meaning “Sky or Universe Touch” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anshul usually hope their child will grow to embody sky or universe touch and live with faith, good character and purpose.
